Key Findings

Data Obtained

  • Customer contracts and rate cards
  • Customs declarations and shipping manifests
  • Driver records, licences and tachograph data
  • Payroll and HR files
  • Finance: invoices, credit control, bank statements
  • Warehouse management system database exports
